text.content:
name: changed
version: 1.0.0
module:
  id: raes/fixture-family
  version: 1.0.0
  exports:
    nodes:
    - primary
    - secondary
    content:
    - payload
    variation_points:
    - payload-host
nodes:
  primary:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1 GiB
      cpu: 1
  secondary:
    type: compute
    resources:
      ram: 1 GiB
      cpu: 1
content:
  payload:
    type: file
    target: primary
    path: /opt/payload
variation_points:
  private-host:
    kind: alternative
    target:
      kind: reference
      owner: payload
      slot: content.target
    alternatives:
      primary-host:
        reference: primary
      secondary-host:
        reference: secondary
  payload-host:
    kind: alternative
    target:
      kind: reference
      owner: payload
      slot: content.target
    alternatives:
      primary-host:
        reference: primary
        requires:
        - point: private-host
          members:
          - primary-host
      secondary-host:
        reference: secondary
